title: Prepare typed contract fields
responsibility: Prepares declared callable contracts and shared type fields with honest examples and source gaps.

inputs.name: typeLabel.type
inputs.description: The public type expression to display, which may contain an inferred import('...') path. Only quoted module specifiers are removed, whitespace collapses to single spaces, and a result that is empty afterwards is shown as 'module'.

inputs.name: fieldOf.item
inputs.description: The declared input, output or error entry to present; its readable name is the last dotted segment of its name, and its trimmed description, own default and non-empty examples carry over. Without examples, a type that is plain data gets one illustrative value instead.

examples.name: typeLabel.type
examples.description: The public type expression to display, which may contain an inferred import('...') path. Only quoted module specifiers are removed, whitespace collapses to single spaces, and a result that is empty afterwards is shown as 'module'.

examples.name: fieldOf
examples.description: A readable field whose name is the last dotted segment of the item name, keeping the item's required flag and own default (false, 0, null and empty text included); its source is declared for authored examples, illustrative for a placeholder of plain data, or missing when neither applies.

examples.name: TypeError
examples.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify when an authored example holds BigInt or circular data; nothing in these files catches it.

inputs.name: fieldOf.unit
inputs.description: The unit whose title, owned symbols and owned source file names decide whether a markup item reads as 'rendered markup' rather than its own name. No other part of the field depends on it.

examples.title: Prepare typed contract fields
examples.responsibility: Prepares declared callable contracts and shared type fields with honest examples and source gaps.

inputs.name: typeLabel.type
inputs.description: The public type expression to display, which may contain an inferred import('...') path. Only quoted module specifiers are removed, whitespace collapses to single spaces, and a result that is empty afterwards is shown as 'module'.

outputs.name: typeLabel
outputs.description: The type expression with each quoted import(...) path and its trailing dot removed, whitespace collapsed and trimmed, or 'module' when nothing remains.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify when an authored example holds BigInt or circular data; nothing in these files catches it.

inputs.name: contractFields.unit
inputs.description: The unit whose contract inputs, outputs and errors become the field groups; for the types category, its non-class model definitions in its owned source become the groups instead, and its contract inputs supply the method requirement flags.

outputs.name: typeLabel

errors.name: TypeError

inputs.name: contractFields.category
inputs.description: The entity category: types lists its model definitions as groups, components title the inputs Props and omit the outputs, configs title the outputs Provides, and every other category titles them Inputs and Outputs.

inputs.name: contractFacts.rows
inputs.description: The prepared contract rows; rows labelled Inputs, Props, Output, Fails with or Provides are dropped because the field groups already show them, and the remaining rows, such as Purpose, are kept.

examples.label: Inputs
examples.value: type, item, unit, category, rows, declared, callable, depth

examples.label: Output
examples.value: type label, contract fields, contract facts, callable contracts, field of, return field, guess

examples.label: Fails with
examples.value: type error, range error, getter, proxy or conversion error

inputs.name: contractFacts.unit
inputs.description: The unit whose runtime targets are read, for functions only: each target kind becomes a readable name (module, wasm, process and http map to Module, Wasm, Native process and HTTP; other kinds stay as written), and with no targets its runtime kind, named the same way, is shown.

inputs.name: contractFacts.category
inputs.description: The entity category; only functions add a 'Runs as' row listing their execution targets, and every other category returns the remaining rows as they are.

inputs.name: callableContracts.unit
inputs.description: The unit whose recorded helpers each become one callable entry, with inputs and outputs matched to its contract by name and errors matched by the helper's name prefix. A unit with a single helper takes all its errors and, when no output matches, its first output.

inputs.name: typeLabel.type
inputs.description: The public type expression to display, which may contain an inferred import('...') path. Only quoted module specifiers are removed, whitespace collapses to single spaces, and a result that is empty afterwards is shown as 'module'.

outputs.name: typeLabel
outputs.description: The type expression with each quoted import(...) path and its trailing dot removed, whitespace collapsed and trimmed, or 'module' when nothing remains.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify when an authored example holds BigInt or circular data; nothing in these files catches it.

inputs.name: returnField.declared
inputs.description: The authored output entry of the callable, or undefined when none is declared. Without one, or when its name equals the callable name, the field is named returnValue and its examples come from the declared entry if it has any, otherwise from its type.

examples.name: fieldOf
examples.description: A readable field whose name is the last dotted segment of the item name, keeping the item's required flag and own default (false, 0, null and empty text included); its source is declared for authored examples, illustrative for a placeholder of plain data, or missing when neither applies.

examples.name: guess
examples.description: A { value } wrapper around a bounded placeholder when the type is plain data within the depth limit, or undefined when the type cannot be represented.

examples.name: typeLabel
examples.description: The type expression with each quoted import(...) path and its trailing dot removed, whitespace collapsed and trimmed, or 'module' when nothing remains.

inputs.name: returnField.type
inputs.description: The return type as declared: void gives the field the description 'This function returns no value.' with no examples, and any other type has its import path removed, is shown as the type, and builds an illustrative value when it is plain data and no examples are declared.

inputs.name: returnField.callable
inputs.description: The canonical name of the callable that returns this value; a declared output named exactly this way gives returnValue, and a declared name that begins with this name and a dot loses that prefix to become the return name.

inputs.name: returnField.unit
inputs.description: Only passed on to the field builder, whose readable name this function replaces with the return name, so the unit does not change the returned field.

inputs.name: guess.type
inputs.description: The type expression a placeholder is built for: primitives, literals, arrays, Record<string, ...> and markup are handled, a union only when every member is, and named or opaque types such as Item yield undefined.

inputs.name: guess.depth
inputs.description: The current nesting level: a field's own example starts at 0, each union or array level adds one, and a depth above 4 yields undefined.

outputs.name: typeLabel
outputs.description: The type expression with each quoted import(...) path and its trailing dot removed, whitespace collapsed and trimmed, or 'module' when nothing remains.

outputs.name: contractFields
outputs.description: The field groups of an entity: Inputs (Props for components), Outputs (Provides for configs, absent for components) and Errors, or for types one group per non-class model definition. Model fields set required from their optional flag and carry source 'missing' with no invented default, callable members keep their authored requirement flags, and other fields keep each item's declared required flag, default and examples.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The public type expression to display, which may contain an inferred import('...') path. Only quoted module specifiers are removed, whitespace collapses to single spaces, and a result that is empty afterwards is shown as 'module'.

outputs.name: contractFacts
outputs.description: The contract's rows that the field groups do not already show, plus a 'Runs as' row for functions naming their execution targets, falling back to the runtime kind.

outputs.name: callableContracts
outputs.type: { name: string; signature: string; groups: ContractGroup[] }[]
outputs.description: One entry per recorded callable, with its signature, a Parameters group whose fields keep the matched input's required flag and own default, a Returns group holding the named return value, and a Throws group listing its errors or stating 'No errors declared.'

fields.name: type

fields.name: depth
fields.description: The current nesting level: a field's own example starts at 0, each union or array level adds one, and a depth above 4 yields undefined.

fields.name: returnValue
fields.description: A { value } wrapper around a bounded placeholder when the type is plain data within the depth limit, or undefined when the type cannot be represented.

errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify when an authored example nests too deeply for the serializer's call stack; nothing in these files catches it.
